resources.string: DM
DM opens Instagram’s recipient picker. Enable SAO for Instagram in an API-102 LSPosed framework to send photos directly.
Open Instagram once to enable DM attachments, then reopen this picker.
Attach this media in an Instagram direct message
Send this media directly to the original Instagram conversation; sends immediately
Paste this media into the original Instagram conversation using LSPosed; sends immediately
Paste or DM sends the photo directly to the original conversation.
GIF Paste is not supported by the native handler. Use DM.
%1$s (Instagram %2$s)
Instagram is running older SAO hooks. Reopen Instagram after updating SAO.
Instagram’s video handler is still loading. Reopen the picker shortly.
SAO could not load this build’s Instagram video handler. DM is available.
SAO could not bind Instagram’s DM controller. Reopen the picker inside the chat.
Instagram restricts media in this conversation. Check its message request permissions.
Instagram’s current DM controller has no compatible video sender. DM is available.
More than one Instagram composer is visible. Open only the intended chat.
The video handler is ready. Close and reopen the picker in this chat.
Instagram did not capture the DM in time. Reopen the picker in this chat.
Instagram accepted the photo send request.
Paste or DM sends the video directly to the original conversation through Instagram’s gallery handler.
Instagram accepted the video send request.
Paste or DM uploads the GIF directly to the original conversation.
Instagram accepted the GIF send request.
Paste converts this video to a GIF at full resolution and sends it to the original conversation without audio.
